brief:
Israeli forces killed at least seven Palestinians, including a father and his 13-year-old son, in Gaza on Tuesday, according to local health officials cited by Middle East Eye. The strikes occurred in the Gaza Strip, where an escalating military operation has caused widespread civilian casualties over recent weeks.

No further details about the location of the strikes, circumstances of the incident, or identity of the other victims were provided by officials.
dek: Israeli fire kills seven, including a father and son, in Gaza Israeli forces killed at least seven Palestinians, including a father and his 13-year-old son, in the Gaza Strip on Tuesday, local health officials said.
title: Israeli fire kills seven Palestinians in Gaza, including father and child
